description: This file contains unit tests for the Result class in the org.openmrs.logic.result package, verifying its behavior with various scenarios including date ordering, null handling, and type conversions.

classes.name: ResultTest
classes.description: Contains JUnit test cases to validate the functionality of the Result class in various conditions.

methods.name: toObject_shouldReturnResultObjectForSingleResults
methods.description: Verifies that a Result containing a date, value, and Encounter can be converted back to the original object.

methods.name: Result_shouldNotFailWithNullList
methods.description: Ensures that initializing Result with a null list does not throw an exception.

methods.name: Result_shouldNotFailWithEmptyList
methods.description: Ensures that initializing Result with an empty list does not throw an exception.

methods.name: Result_shouldNotFailWithNullResult
methods.description: Ensures that initializing Result with null does not throw an exception.

methods.name: earliest_shouldGetTheFirstResultGivenMultipleResults
methods.description: Checks that the earliest() method returns the Result with the earliest date among multiple results.

methods.name: earliest_shouldGetTheResultGivenASingleResult
methods.description: Checks that earliest() correctly returns the only result when a single result exists.

methods.name: earliest_shouldGetAnEmptyResultGivenAnEmptyResult
methods.description: Verifies that earliest() returns an EmptyResult when called on an empty Result.

methods.name: earliest_shouldNotGetTheResultWithNullResultDateGivenOtherResults
methods.description: Checks that null dates are handled correctly when determining the earliest result.

methods.name: earliest_shouldGetOneResultWithNullResultDatesForAllResults
methods.description: Ensures that when all results have null dates, earliest() returns one of them.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueOnTwoEmptyResults
methods.description: Validates that two empty results are considered equal.

methods.name: get_shouldGetEmptyResultForIndexesOutOfRange
methods.description: Ensures requesting an index beyond the list size returns an EmptyResult.

methods.name: isNull_shouldReturnFalse
methods.description: Checks that a default Result object is not null.

methods.name: latest_shouldGetTheMostRecentResultGivenMultipleResults
methods.description: Verifies that latest() returns the result with the most recent date.

methods.name: latest_shouldGetTheResultGivenASingleResult
methods.description: Checks latest() with a single result.

methods.name: latest_shouldGetAnEmptyResultGivenAnEmptyResult
methods.description: Ensures latest() on an empty Result returns an EmptyResult.

methods.name: latest_shouldGetTheResultWithNullResultDate
methods.description: Handles null dates appropriately when computing the latest result.

methods.name: toObject_shouldFailWhenContainsMultipleResults
methods.description: Verifies that converting Result to object throws LogicException if multiple results exist.
